ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 60% high-intensity white pixels and 40% low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous low-intensity (black) region originating from the central peduncle area and extending in a wedge shape towards the mid-lobes. High-intensity (white) contiguous regions occupy the distal half of both lobes. Extensive low-intensity (black) mottling and speckling are distributed across the high-intensity regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory extending from the median notch to the lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal margins of both fluke lobes.
